patch_resolves_note: The staged fix deletes the heap-backed `malloc(size)` / `FUZZ_dataProducer_create(uncompressedData, size)` path, derives `uncompressedData` from the original fuzz input with fuzz-chosen offsets, and on the exact witness reaches the same `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` call with `uncompressedSize = 0`, so the call no longer admits uninitialized heap bytes into the library.
verification_limitations: On the exact fixed witness, the patched fuzzer chooses a zero-length uncompressed slice (`uncompressedSize = 0`), so the downstream `auto_flush_dispatch` and `hash_position_sink` events are not exercised on the fixed side; only the root call-site obligation is witnessed differentially.

nodes.description: Inside the `if ((cctxPtr->prefs.autoFlush) && (srcPtr < srcEnd))` branch, `LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl()` dispatches the remaining short uncompressed input directly to `LZ4F_makeBlock()` instead of buffering it.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `auto_flush_dispatch.src_remaining=18` and `auto_flush_dispatch.block_size=65536` at the branch-local event, so the remaining input is a short block that the autoFlush path forwards immediately.

nodes.description: At `LZ4_hashPosition()`, the selected hash path reads 4 bytes from `p`, and in the vulnerable execution that read extends past the initialized prefix of the admitted uncompressed buffer.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `hash_position_sink.hash_read_width=4` and `hash_position_sink.hash_initialized_prefix_len=0` immediately before the `LZ4_read32(p)` sink executes.

edges.description: The same `uncompressedData` pointer admitted by `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` becomes the `srcPtr` value dispatched by the later autoFlush short-block branch.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `uncompressed_update_root.uncompressed_data_ptr == auto_flush_dispatch.src_buffer_ptr`.

edges.description: The short uncompressed source pointer dispatched by `LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl()` reaches `LZ4_hashPosition()` unchanged as the `p` pointer whose first bytes are hashed.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace records `auto_flush_dispatch.src_buffer_ptr == hash_position_sink.hash_input_ptr`.

root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `uncompressedData[0..uncompressedSize)` is initialized before `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate(ctx, ..., uncompressedData, uncompressedSize, NULL)`.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `compress_round_trip()` calls `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` on `uncompressedData`, every byte in the selected `uncompressedSize` segment must already be initialized.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable fuzzer reaches the uncompressed-update call with `uncompressedData` still pointing to raw `malloc(size)` heap memory and `uncompressedSize = 18`. The fixed original reaches the same call after deriving `uncompressedData` from the input buffer and, on the exact witness, chooses a zero-length slice (`uncompressedSize = 0`), so the call no longer passes uninitialized heap bytes into the library.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original reaches `uncompressed_update_root` with `uncompressed_initialized_prefix_len=0` and `uncompressed_size=18`, so the required predicate is violated at the protected `LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate()` call. The fixed original reaches the same call genuinely with `uncompressed_initialized_prefix_len=0` and `uncompressed_size=0`, satisfying the source-level obligation for the exact witness.
